info.title: Fleet Management System API
info.description:
Vehicle tracking, telemetry, geolocation and notification APIs behind a single API Gateway.

### Two layers of security
| Layer | Where | Mechanism | Answers |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Gateway authentication** | API Gateway | `x-api-key` header (`ApiKeyAuth`) | "Is this client allowed to call the platform?" → 401 |
| **Backend authorization** | Backend services | `Authorization: Bearer <JWT>` (`BearerAuth`) + role (RBAC) | "Who is the user and what may they do?" → 401 / 403 |

- **Login/register:** API key only. **Vehicle read:** API key + JWT. **Vehicle delete:** API key + JWT + `admin` role. **/health, /api-docs:** public.
- Roles: `admin` (everything), `fleet_manager` (create/update vehicles, telemetry, geocoding, notification history), `viewer` (read-only).
- Rate limiting: per IP, configurable; 429 with `RateLimit-*` headers.
- Geocoding uses OpenStreetMap Nominatim — data © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL).

Click **Authorize** to enter the API key and (after calling login) the JWT.

cached.description: true when served from cache (no Nominatim request made)

BadRequest.description: Missing/invalid parameters, validation failure or malformed JSON (gateway: `MALFORMED_JSON`)

example.message: name, email and password are required

Unauthorized.description: Gateway: missing/invalid `x-api-key` (`MISSING_API_KEY` / `INVALID_API_KEY`). Backend: missing/invalid/expired JWT or bad credentials.

example.message: The provided API key is invalid.

Forbidden.description: Authenticated, but the JWT role is not allowed for this route

example.message: Role 'viewer' is not authorized to access this route

AddressNotFound.description: Nominatim found no match for the address

example.message: A record with that vehicleId already exists

RateLimited.description: Gateway rate limit exceeded (`RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED`, `AUTH_RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED`) or geocoder upstream limit (`GEOCODER_RATE_LIMITED`). Standard `RateLimit-*` and `Retry-After` headers are returned.

example.message: Too many requests from this IP. Please try again later.

GeocoderError.description: Geocoding provider returned an error or invalid coordinates (`GEOCODER_ERROR`, `GEOCODER_UNAVAILABLE`, `GEOCODER_INVALID_COORDINATES`)

example.message: The vehicle service is currently unavailable.
The vehicle service did not respond in time.

get.description: Public. Not rate limited and requires no API key or JWT. Returns status only — never URLs, keys or secrets. 503 when any backend is unreachable.

503.description: One or more services degraded or unavailable

post.description: Creates a user and returns a JWT. Needs the API key only (no JWT). Gateway authentication: `x-api-key`. Backend authorization: `Authorization: Bearer <JWT>` + role check.

post.summary: Log in and obtain a JWT
post.description: Requires the API key but **not** a JWT. Stricter rate limit applies (brute-force protection). Gateway authentication: `x-api-key`. Backend authorization: `Authorization: Bearer <JWT>` + role check.

get.description: Case-insensitive partial match. Any authenticated role.

delete.description: **Required role:** admin only. A fleet_manager or viewer JWT yields 403.

patch.description: **Required role:** admin, fleet_manager. Also triggers a STATUS_CHANGE MockSMS notification.

post.description: **Required role:** admin, fleet_manager. Updates the vehicle's last known GPS location and battery. engineTemperature > 110 auto-flags ENGINE_FAULT; batteryLevel < 20 auto-flags LOW_BATTERY. Critical events send a MockSMS notification (the mock fails ~15% of the time by design; failures are recorded with status "failed").

get.summary: Recent telemetry events across the fleet
get.description: Any authenticated role. Newest first. Used by the dashboard.

parameters.name: hours
parameters.description: Only events from the last N hours

post.description: **Required role:** admin, fleet_manager. Converts an address to coordinates using Nominatim. Results are cached (memory + MongoDB) and requests are serialised to ≤1/second per the Nominatim usage policy, so uncached calls may take 1–2 s. Data © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL).

post.summary: Geocode an address and save it to a vehicle
post.description: **Required role:** admin, fleet_manager. Verifies the vehicle exists first (an unknown ID never costs a Nominatim request), then stores address + coordinates on it.

get.description: Any authenticated role. Computed locally with the Haversine formula over stored coordinates — never calls Nominatim.
